Pain management · West Chester, PA

Specialized pain, migraine & injection care in West Chester.

Located in Westtown Business Center near Routes 3 and 352, our small office provides individualized care for pain, migraines, and related conditions. Your treatment plan reflects your specific needs.

Call (610) 732-4251Explore services

Visiting us? Find the office at 1572 McDaniel Drive, West Chester, PA 19380.

What we offer

Care matched to your needs

Chronic pain management services may be considered after an individual evaluation. Your clinician will discuss the options that fit your situation.

01 / PROCEDURES

Pain procedures

Cervical, thoracic and lumbar epidural injections; nerve root, facet, medial branch and sacroiliac joint blocks; radiofrequency ablation (RFA); trigger point and cortisone injections.

02 / HEADACHE CARE

Migraine treatment

Botox for chronic migraine and medications such as Aimovig, Ajovy, Emgality, Vyepti, Nurtec and Ubrelvy.

03 / JOINT CARE

Knee injections

Hip, knee and shoulder joint injections, including knee treatments such as Synvisc, Orthovisc and Monovisc.

04 / MEDICATIONS

Medication management

Medication management, low-dose naltrexone and, when appropriate after evaluation, chronic opioid therapy. The clinic also lists urine drug screening.

05 / ADDICTION CARE

Suboxone & Sublocade

Suboxone therapy, including treatment for opioid addiction, and Sublocade injections.

06 / ADDITIONAL CARE

Other services

Medication-assisted weight loss for obesity, with medications such as phentermine, Wegovy and Zepbound; testosterone replacement therapy; and Spravato for depression.

The clinic also lists spinal cord stimulators. Treatment availability and eligibility are determined by the clinic. Call to discuss a specific service.

About the practice

Meet Dr. Garg

Dr. Garg is board certified in Pain Management, Anesthesiology, and Internal Medicine. He trained in Internal Medicine at UMDNJ and completed Anesthesiology and Pain Management training at the University of Rochester in New York.

Dr. Garg combines conventional and complementary approaches, including injections, medications, physical therapy, behavioral therapy, massage, chiropractic care and acupuncture. Treatment plans are individualized.

Frequently asked questions

Before you call

How do I find a pain clinic near me that offers personalized treatment?

Schedule an evaluation to discuss your condition and which treatment options may fit your needs.

What happens at a first pain management visit?

The doctor reviews your history and symptoms, examines you and recommends a treatment plan.

Are there non-surgical options for back or joint pain?

The clinic lists injections, therapy and medication management among its treatment options. The right choice depends on your evaluation.

Can I get treatment for migraine, fibromyalgia or neuropathic pain near West Chester?

The clinic provides care for chronic migraine, fibromyalgia and neuropathic pain, including diabetic neuropathy. An evaluation helps determine which treatments may be suitable for your condition.

What insurance plans do you accept?

See the insurance list. It was last dated October 2023, and the clinic homepage gives different guidance about Medicare Advantage. Confirm your plan with the office.

Does the clinic prescribe opioids for pain?

Opioid therapy may be considered as a last resort after careful evaluation when other options have failed or proved inadequate. It carries risks, including addiction and overdose, and is not appropriate for everyone.

Can the clinic evaluate me for medical marijuana?

The clinic states that it can evaluate patients with a state-approved diagnosis. Call to confirm current eligibility and process.
